data.fund_type: An open ended equity scheme investing in Infrastructure sector
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to generate long-term growth from a portfolio of equity / equity related instruments of companies engaged either directly or indirectly in the infrastructure sector. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be realized.
data.asset_allocation: Equity and equity related instruments of companies engaged either directly or indirectly in the infrastructure sector:80-100%, Debt and Money Market instruments:0-20%. Please refer the Scheme Information Document for complete details.
data.fund_managers: FM 1: Mr. Yogesh Patil ; FM 2: Mr. Mahesh Bendre
data.exit_load: 12% of the units allotted shall be redeemed or switched out without any exit load, on or before completion of 90 days from the date of allotment of units. 1% on remaining units if redeemed or switched out on or before completion of 90 days from the date of allotment of units. Nil, if redeemed or switched out after completion of 90 days from the date of allotment of units.
